description: Stop hook: hand the turn back to the agent until clippy, oxlint, and typecheck pass warning-free.

hooks.command: runtime="$(command -v bun || command -v node)"; root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; "$runtime" "$root/scripts/stop-check.ts"
hooks.statusMessage: Checking sl clippy, lint, and types
